description:
Who are we?

At HubSpot, we empower thousands of businesses around the world to grow better. If you thrive in solving complex challenges, love learning, and enjoy collaborating with a global team, this role could be your next great opportunity. Our Australian office is based in Sydney, but we’re equally happy for you to join our team as a remote employee. For more information, check out: Hybrid at HubSpot

AI is changing how businesses buy. Buyers arrive informed, and they want to see their own business running in HubSpot, with proof it will deliver results, before they commit. HubSpot's customer platform connects customer context, Breeze AI agents and a unified CRM, so growing businesses get real outcomes, not just new software.

What’s the role

As a Lead Solutions Engineer working with our Upmarket sales org (Midmarket/Corp), you'll partner with Account Executives to show mid-sized businesses what HubSpot can do for them, then prove it. You'll lead discovery, tell outcome-led stories through tailored demos, and build lightweight working proofs so customers can try their solution before they buy.

This is a pre-sales role, not a software engineering role. It suits people who enjoy business conversations as much as building with technology, and who want to grow their technical, customer, communication and sales skills fast.

If you love storytelling and building, you thrive at the intersection of business and technology, and want to help write the playbook for how software is bought next, this role is for you.

What you'll do

  • Work a varied pipeline of new and existing-customer deals alongside Account Executives, from discovery to the technical win.
  • Lead discovery to understand each customer's goals, pain points, current systems and requirements.
  • Tell compelling, outcome-led stories (via demos and product led experiences) that show customers how their business can be reimagined in HubSpot
  • Partner with Account Executives to map the technical buying committee, competitive landscape and path to a decision.
  • Design HubSpot solutions that fit the customer's processes and connect sensibly with the tools they already use.
  • Build lightweight proofs of concept with AI tools, Breeze AI agents and HubSpot configuration, scoped to clear use cases and success criteria, and help customers try them hands-on.
  • Answer ad-hoc or RFP-based technical, security and integration questions, collaborating with specialists and partners as needed.
  • Help your AE shape the business case and value story for the customer's first use cases. Prove the outcome via use-case roadmap and a consumption plan that sizes the first commitment.
  • Keep what you show realistic to deploy, and hand over clear context to solution architects, onboarding teams and partners so customers start strong and realise value fast.
  • Lead by example: mentor other SEs, run initiatives, share field feedback and reusable assets with the team to improve our playbooks and product.
  • Travel occasionally to customer sites.

What you’ll bring:

  • Experience in a customer-facing technical or consultative role for a SaaS product, such as solutions engineering, technical consulting, implementation, onboarding or customer success with a track record of winning complex deals or delivering solutions that moved business results.
  • Humility and a growth mindset: the world of SaaS is changing fast and there is a lot of ambiguity. Nobody can know everything. You’re happy to lead from the front where needed and offer your support to team mates while equally being open to learn from others.
  • Art-of-the-Possible Storytelling: Ability to turn a customer's goals into a compelling, outcome-led vision of their business reimagined in HubSpot.
  • Outstanding communication skills & stakeholder management - both internal and external: you feel equally comfortable talking to IT as to C-suite, you can tell a story about business outcomes that resonates with stakeholders at various levels and you can successfully navigate multiple internal & external stakeholders.
  • Curiosity in discovery: you ask good questions, dig deep into business, financial and individual pain, and pick up on needs customers don't explicitly share.
  • Working knowledge of how SaaS platforms connect, including APIs, integrations and data migration and management.
  • Hands-on experience building with AI tools, either professionally or in a personal project, and a demonstrable habit of learning as tools evolve.
  • Manage a complex, multi-stakeholder pipeline independently, surfacing technical, commercial and timing risks before they land

Nice to have

  • Hands-on experience with HubSpot or a similar CRM platform.
  • Projects you've built, deployed or hosted yourself, for example a portfolio you can walk us through.
  • Experience with business cases, ROI conversations or consumption-based pricing (seats and credits).
  • Experience supporting customers in their own environments after the sale.

We have several roles open at different levels within this team within our Mid-Market and Corp segments. During the process, if we believe your experience may align more closely with another level/segment, we’ll discuss this with you and outline potential next steps.

HubSpot offers a flexible, supportive environment designed to help you do your best work and grow your career:

  • Competitive base salary, commissions and stock options
  • Remote-first flexibility - work from home, the office, or hybrid
  • Structured onboarding and ongoing learning opportunities (including an annual education allowance)
  • Flexible Time Off policy
  • Healthcare and wellness reimbursements
  • Primary and Secondary Caregiver Leave
  • Employee Resource Groups and inclusion programs to support belonging
  • Volunteering time so you can give back to your community
  • Consistently recognised as a great place to work by Comparably.

Check out HubSpot’s careers site to see all our benefits and learn more about our culture.

HubSpot’s culture is driven by a shared passion for our mission and metrics. It’s a culture of amazing, growth-minded people who solve for the customer, embrace boldness and adaptability, and thrive on alignment and collaboration. We know the confidence gap and impostor syndrome can get in the way of meeting spectacular candidates, so please don’t hesitate to apply - we’d love to hear from you.

At HubSpot, we value both flexibility and connection. Whether you’re a Remote employee or work from the Office, we want you to start your journey here by building strong connections with your team and peers. If you are joining our Engineering team, you will be required to attend a regional HubSpot office for in-person onboarding. If you join our broader Product team, you’ll also attend other in-person events, such as your Product Group Summit and other gatherings, to continue building on those connections.

If you require an accommodation due to travel limitations or other reasons, please inform your recruiter during the hiring process. We are committed to supporting candidates who may need alternative arrangements

About HubSpot

HubSpot (NYSE: HUBS) is an AI-powered customer platform with all the software, integrations, and resources customers need to connect marketing, sales, and service. HubSpot's connected platform enables businesses to grow faster by focusing on what matters most: customers. 

At HubSpot, bold is our baseline. Our employees around the globe move fast, stay customer-obsessed, and win together. Our culture is grounded in four commitments: Solve for the Customer, Be Bold, Learn Fast, Align, Adapt & Go!, and Deliver with HEART. These commitments shape how we work, lead, and grow.

We’re building a company where people can do their best work. We focus on brilliant work, not badge swipes. By combining clarity, ownership, and trust, we create space for big thinking and meaningful progress. And we know that when our employees grow, our customers do too.

Recognized globally for our award-winning culture by Comparably, Glassdoor, Fortune, and more, HubSpot is headquartered in Cambridge, MA, with employees and offices around the world.
